sources.Observations / Variables: Temperature; salinity; oxygen; nutrients; chlorophyll; tracers; plankton and many other profile variables

sources.Observations / Variables: SST; air temperature; SLP; wind; humidity; waves; clouds/weather; platform metadata

sources.Observations / Variables: T/S; currents; waves; sea level; BGC variables depending product/source

sources.Spatial Coverage: Primarily U.S.-operated deployments; may include international collaborative missions

sources.Repository / Network Period: Dataset-dependent; 2002-present portal with older contributed observations
